callPolicy: One independent Image Gen call per semantic icon; no atlas generation or crop reuse.
sizePolicy: The 128 px Default asset is the reviewed runtime source. The 64/32/16 and Dark/Clear files are deterministic Theme Lab review derivatives, not separately authored artwork.
commonPrompt: Create one isolated macOS Tahoe 26 Liquid Glass system icon: thin optically clear glass, crisp restrained highlights, blue-silver edge refraction, subtle dimensional depth, premium Apple system-icon finish. Center the subject on a flat chroma-key canvas with no cast shadow outside the object, floor, scene, readable text, letters, watermark, border, or extra objects. Preserve a clean legible silhouette at 16–32 px; avoid thick acrylic, bubbly toy styling, excessive gloss, and Snow Leopard candy. Application icons may use a rounded-square enclosure; Finder objects, media, folders, documents, hardware, trash, and the Control Strip stay free-form.
